note: Washington County IN publishes its zoning only as a PDF ordinance/zoning map on the county Planning Commission page. The county GIS (washingtonin.wthgis.com) is a parcel viewer with no ArcGIS REST zoning service found (/arcgis/rest/services returns 404). City of Washington's zoning page links only a PDF ordinance. ArcGIS searches found no official zoning district service for the county or its cities; only third-party copies (Zoneomics, Regrid) exist.
